periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented diagonally downward toward the snout at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches are vertically elongated ovals with an approximate height-to-width ratio of 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches exhibit a significant downward extension, with the bulk of the pigment mass located below the ocular horizontal midline.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a cranial gap approximately equal to 1.2 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior contours of the ears are smoothly rounded with a continuous convex profile.

other_distinctive_markers: The thoracic and abdominal fur displays a matted, spiked texture, indicating a wet or recently cleaned state.
